answer: Each agent here wears a ferrous slug, coin-sized with a sable oxide coat, and its surface roughness is the private key. On registration the node heats the slug and reads capacitance twice; the delta between those curves must match the factory record within 0.4%, and that record is hashed into a public burn registry, so a slug enrols once, forever. Cloning 10,000 agents needs 10,000 slugs at $6 plus 10,000 rigs at $40, so $460,000 before the first attestation, and the foundry order outs the farm in a week. A sybil swarm would need a warehouse of coins that can only be spent once.
